results.title: Iran’s President Says Tehran to Resist Until ‘Aggressors Are Regretful’
results.description: Iran will continue its resistance with strength until "aggressors" become regretful and its rights are defended, President Masoud Pezeshkian said on Tuesday, pointing ‌to a ‌less conciliatory ‌tone ⁠from Tehran.

results.title: UK commits £100m to boost Ukraine air defences over winter
results.description: Defence interceptors, large-calibre artillery rounds and drones will be supplied to Ukraine.

results.title: Azerbaijan, China plan to develop relations in public administration
results.description: The opening of the China Center at the Academy of Public Administration (DIA) under the President of Azerbaijan will lay the foundation for the further development of cooperation between Baku and Beijing in the fields of education and public administration, Deputy Chairman and Head of the Central Apparatus of the New Azerbaijan Party Tahir Budagov said at the opening of the China Center, Report informs.

results.title: Reform UK MP calls for Gibraltar to get its own Westminster seat ahead of National Day celebrations
results.description: A REFORM UK MP has suggested the Rock could be represented at Westminster by its own elected MP if his party forms the next UK government.
